lines.zh: 我踩着长腿穿过战场，去找伤员。
lines.en: I wade through the battle on long legs, seeking the wounded.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕踩到倒下的同伴。
lines.en: I step slowly so I don't tread on fallen kin.

lines.zh: 面具给了我方向，我朝喊声走。
lines.en: The mask gives me direction; I walk toward the cries.

lines.zh: 我绕过焦土，那边没人需要我。
lines.en: I skirt the burnt ground; no one needs me there.

lines.zh: 长脖子探出去，我数着还有几个在动。
lines.en: My long neck reaches out; I count who still moves.

lines.zh: 我的影子太细，猎物常看不见。
lines.en: My shadow is too thin; prey seldom sees it.

lines.zh: 我沿着血味走，不会走错。
lines.en: I follow the smell of blood; I won't lose the way.

lines.zh: 三步一停，我确认风向。
lines.en: Three steps, one pause — I check the wind.

lines.zh: 腿上的旧伤让我有点跛。
lines.en: An old wound makes my stride a little uneven.

lines.zh: 我往最安静的地方走，那儿伤最重。
lines.en: I head where it's quietest; the worst wounds lie there.

lines.zh: 喙里衔着草药，我不能开口。
lines.en: I carry herbs in my beak and cannot speak.

lines.zh: 我跟在猛禽后面，它开路，我救。
lines.en: I follow the raptor: it clears, I mend.

lines.zh: 翅收在身侧，我尽量不惊动谁。
lines.en: Wings tucked tight, I try not to startle anyone.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草会慢慢立起来。
lines.en: The grass slowly rights itself where I pass.

lines.zh: 我把药草换到喙的另一侧。
lines.en: I shift the herbs to the other side of my beak.

lines.zh: 我轻轻落脚，怕惊了躺下的人。
lines.en: I set my feet down gently, so the fallen aren't startled.

lines.zh: 我单腿站着，听远处的翅膀声。
lines.en: I stand on one leg, listening for wings far off.

lines.zh: 面具在我面前缓缓转。
lines.en: The mask turns slowly before me.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进胸羽里暖一暖。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my chest feathers to warm it.

lines.zh: 没有伤员的时候，我不知道做什么。
lines.en: With no wounded to tend, I don't know what to do.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个我救回来的同伴。
lines.en: I remember every flockmate I brought back.

lines.zh: 太阳落一点，我的力气也落一点。
lines.en: As the sun sinks, my strength sinks with it.

lines.zh: 远处传来一声痛叫，我抬头。
lines.en: A cry of pain carries; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我数着面具上的纹路，数到七就停。
lines.en: I count the mask's grooves and stop at seven.

lines.zh: 风把我的长颈吹得发凉。
lines.en: The wind chills my long neck.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，站太久了。
lines.en: My legs tremble; I've stood too long.

lines.zh: 食人鹤这名字不是我选的。
lines.en: Man-eating crane is not a name I chose.

lines.zh: 我听见草里有虫，但我不吃虫。
lines.en: I hear insects in the grass; I don't eat insects.

lines.zh: 你身上有新伤，我闻得到。
lines.en: I smell fresh wounds on you.

lines.zh: 你不是乌姆塔纳，你的骨头太重。
lines.en: You aren't Umvuthana; your bones are too heavy.

lines.zh: 你要我治你，还是杀你？
lines.en: Do you want me to heal you, or kill you?

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，别缩回去。
lines.en: Let me see your hand — don't pull it back.

lines.zh: 面具在你面前停住，然后转开。
lines.en: The mask stops before you, then turns away.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸不匀，肋下有问题。
lines.en: Your breathing is uneven; something's wrong under your ribs.

lines.zh: 你带着武器，我就站远一点。
lines.en: You carry a weapon, so I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 你在找什么？这片战场没有药。
lines.en: What are you looking for? There's no medicine on this field.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是为了看清你的伤口。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see your wound clearly.

lines.zh: 你要是太阳鸟的敌人，我就不走。
lines.en: If you're the Sunbird's enemy, I'm not leaving.

lines.zh: 我的翅被折了，还能走。
lines.en: My wing is broken; I can still walk.

lines.zh: 这伤我自己治不了。
lines.en: This wound I can't treat myself.

lines.zh: 面具晃了一下，光散成两半。
lines.en: The mask rocks; its light splits in two.

lines.zh: 我倒下前，先记住你的位置。
lines.en: Before I fall, I note where you stand.

lines.zh: 我不喊疼，喊了会有人分心。
lines.en: I don't cry out; it would distract someone.

lines.zh: 长腿断了，我跪着也要治。
lines.en: My long leg is broken; I'll heal on my knees.

lines.zh: 这一击该留给伤员，不该给我。
lines.en: That blow should have gone to the wounded, not me.

lines.zh: 我的血是温的，和你们一样。
lines.en: My blood is warm, like yours.

lines.zh: 我退到后方，不是因为怕。
lines.en: I fall back, and not from fear.

lines.zh: 替我按住伤口，我自己来缝。
lines.en: Press the wound for me; I'll stitch it myself.

lines.zh: 那株草药，能给我吗？
lines.en: That herb — may I have it?

lines.zh: 你手里是金蒲公英？我认识。
lines.en: Golden dandelion in your hand? I know it.

lines.zh: 我靠近一步，只为闻那味道。
lines.en: I come one step closer, only to smell it.

lines.zh: 这味道能压住腐肉的气。
lines.en: This scent can mask the smell of rot.

lines.zh: 放下就好，我不会抢。
lines.en: Just set it down; I won't snatch it.

lines.zh: 我需要它，巢里还有人在烧。
lines.en: I need it; someone in the nest still burns with fever.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，让汁水流出来。
lines.en: Shake it a little so the juice runs.

lines.zh: 我低头，这是求你。
lines.en: I bow my head — this is me begging.

lines.zh: 一整株我都用得上，根也要。
lines.en: I can use the whole plant, root included.

lines.zh: 面具也在朝那株草倾。
lines.en: Even the mask leans toward that herb.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的腿了，我站不稳。
lines.en: You struck my leg; I can't keep my balance.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架经不起第二次撞。
lines.en: This frame of mine won't take a second hit.

lines.zh: 我让开，你先过，别踩我的喙。
lines.en: I step aside; go on, but don't tread on my beak.

lines.zh: 两只食人鹤挤在伤员上方，谁也不走。
lines.en: Two cranes crowd over a wounded one, neither leaving.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，羽毛落了一地。
lines.en: We collide and feathers scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 我翅展开挡了一下，算赔罪。
lines.en: I spread a wing to soften it — my apology.

lines.zh: 你退后，我脚下有个人。
lines.en: Step back; there's someone under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的长腿绊住了自己的脖子。
lines.en: My long legs have tangled under my own neck.

lines.zh: 撞歪了面具，我扶正它。
lines.en: The bump knocked my mask crooked; I set it right.

lines.zh: 这点冲撞，比不上战场上的。
lines.en: This little jolt is nothing next to the battlefield.

lines.zh: 我们不是生出来的，是被面具造出来的。
lines.en: We weren't born; the mask made us.

lines.zh: 若要有伴，就一起守着同一巢伤员。
lines.en: If we're to pair, we'll guard one nest of wounded together.

lines.zh: 我把最软的那根羽给你垫巢。
lines.en: I give you my softest feather to line the nest.

lines.zh: 你替我看北边，我守南边。
lines.en: You watch the north; I hold the south.

lines.zh: 我们的喙碰一下，算是说定了。
lines.en: Our beaks touch once — that settles it.

lines.zh: 太阳鸟允许的事，我才做。
lines.en: I do only what the Sunbird permits.

lines.zh: 两只面具并排悬着，光会合在一起。
lines.en: Two masks hang side by side; their light joins.

lines.zh: 我腿长，孵蛋时反而碍事。
lines.en: My legs are long; they get in the way when brooding.

lines.zh: 你的伤还没好，别急着筑巢。
lines.en: Your wound isn't healed; don't rush to build.

lines.zh: 我们约定：谁先倒下，另一个接着治。
lines.en: We agree: whoever falls first, the other keeps healing.

lines.zh: 这株草我能用，我收下。
lines.en: I can use this herb; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 地上有块布，正好包伤口。
lines.en: A strip of cloth on the ground — good for binding wounds.

lines.zh: 我叼起那根断羽，是同伴的。
lines.en: I pick up a broken feather; it belonged to a flockmate.

lines.zh: 这瓶药是谁掉的？我留着。
lines.en: Whose potion is this? I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我用喙夹起它，很轻。
lines.en: I lift it in my beak; it's very light.

lines.zh: 这块皮子能裁成两条绷带。
lines.en: This hide can be cut into two bandages.

lines.zh: 我把药草按颜色分开捡。
lines.en: I gather the herbs, sorted by color.

lines.zh: 那枚面具碎片还有光，别浪费。
lines.en: That mask shard still glows; don't waste it.

lines.zh: 我只捡能救人的东西。
lines.en: I pick up only what can save someone.

lines.zh: 我脚趾夹不住，只能用喙。
lines.en: My toes can't grip it; only my beak can.

lines.zh: 那个举剑的，先让他躺下。
lines.en: That one raising a sword — put him down first.

lines.zh: 他伤了三个同伴，我记得。
lines.en: He wounded three of my flock; I remember.

lines.zh: 面具的光指向他的胸口。
lines.en: The mask's light points at his chest.

lines.zh: 我先断他的腿，再谈治疗。
lines.en: I'll break his leg first, then discuss healing.

lines.zh: 他在治疗者够不到的地方。
lines.en: He stands where no healer can reach.

lines.zh: 我盯上他，是因为他还在动。
lines.en: I mark him because he's still moving.

lines.zh: 这一场，轮到我动手。
lines.en: This round, it's my turn to strike.

lines.zh: 他背对着我，长喙正好用上。
lines.en: His back is turned; my long beak will serve.

lines.zh: 我要让他也尝尝被剖开的滋味。
lines.en: I'll let him taste being opened up.

lines.zh: 太阳鸟在看着，我不能退。
lines.en: The Sunbird is watching; I cannot withdraw.

lines.zh: 他还在喊人，得先止住。
lines.en: He's still calling for help — that must stop.

lines.zh: 我锁住他的喉咙，不锁别处。
lines.en: I fix on his throat and nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我绕着他走，等他露出侧腹。
lines.en: I circle him, waiting for his flank to show.

lines.zh: 他每退一步，我就进一步。
lines.en: For every step he retreats, I take one.

lines.zh: 我的喙抬着，随时能落。
lines.en: My beak stays raised, ready to fall.

lines.zh: 面具贴着我的颈，告诉我角度。
lines.en: The mask hugs my neck and shows me the angle.

lines.zh: 我不急，治疗者最会等。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; healers know how to wait.

lines.zh: 他挥空了，我从下面穿过去。
lines.en: He swings wide; I slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 他的甲有缝，就在腋下。
lines.en: His armor has a gap, right under the arm.

lines.zh: 我张开翅，让他以为我要飞。
lines.en: I spread my wings so he thinks I'll fly.

lines.zh: 他喘得比我重，他会先累。
lines.en: He's panting harder than I am; he'll tire first.

lines.zh: 我把他的注意力拖在正面。
lines.en: I hold his attention to the front.

lines.zh: 影子被太阳拉长，他看不清我的位置。
lines.en: The sun stretches my shadow; he can't place me.

lines.zh: 再一步，他就进我的长度了。
lines.en: One more step and he's within my reach.

lines.zh: 长喙直取咽喉，一下就够。
lines.en: My long beak goes straight for the throat — one strike suffices.

lines.zh: 我不撕肉，我只切开该切的地方。
lines.en: I don't maul flesh; I cut precisely where it matters.

lines.zh: 这一啄是为了那些没救回来的。
lines.en: This peck is for the ones I couldn't save.

lines.zh: 我先打断他的手，再退开。
lines.en: I break his hand first, then withdraw.

lines.zh: 血溅到面具上，它自己会干。
lines.en: Blood splashes the mask; it dries on its own.

lines.zh: 我出手一次就收，绝不纠缠。
lines.en: I strike once and withdraw; never linger.

lines.zh: 他倒下时，我已经在找下一个。
lines.en: By the time he falls, I'm already seeking the next.

lines.zh: 我的喙比看上去重。
lines.en: My beak is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 这一下，抵得上十次治疗。
lines.en: This single blow is worth ten healings.

lines.zh: 我踩住他的武器，再落喙。
lines.en: I pin his weapon underfoot, then strike.

lines.zh: 面具转了三圈，我从光里站起。
lines.en: The mask turns three times; I rise out of the light.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见的是太阳鸟的影。
lines.en: I open my eyes and first see the Sunbird's silhouette.

lines.zh: 我的腿还很软，站了两次才成。
lines.en: My legs are soft; it takes two tries to stand.

lines.zh: 有人在我耳边说：去治他们。
lines.en: Someone whispers: go heal them.

lines.zh: 我出生时，战场已经打了一半。
lines.en: The battle was half over when I was made.

lines.zh: 面具落在我颈上，像一副轻枷。
lines.en: The mask settles on my neck like a light yoke.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己之前是什么。
lines.en: I don't know what I was before this.

lines.zh: 第一口气里全是铁锈味。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of rust.

lines.zh: 我听见伤者的呻吟，就往那边走。
lines.en: I hear the wounded groaning and walk that way.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在一具尸体上。
lines.en: My shadow falls across a body.

lines.zh: 火会先烧面具，我得护住它。
lines.en: Fire takes the mask first; I must shield it.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我的长腿先折。
lines.en: Falling from height, my long legs break first.

lines.zh: 水没过胸羽，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: Water closes over my chest feathers; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 气浪把药草全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my herbs.

lines.zh: 箭插在翅上，像根多余的羽。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my wing like a feather that doesn't belong.

lines.zh: 这咒语想把我的面具剥下来。
lines.en: This spell is trying to peel my mask off.

lines.zh: 我把最后一口药让给了别人。
lines.en: I gave my last mouthful of medicine to someone else.

lines.zh: 雷落在近处，我的耳还在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck close; my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 没有光的地方，我治不了自己。
lines.en: In a place with no light, I can't heal myself.
